name: PayHOA
positioning: Online HOA management for self-managed associations, sold at a published price per community with a free trial and no sales call.
description: PayHOA is a US web application for managing a homeowners association online. Its financial side covers general ledger accounting, budgets and board reports, bank integrations that remove manual transaction entry, payables and vendor approvals, and an optional bookkeeping service. Its communication side covers mass text, email and phone messaging, one-click USPS mailings through a mailroom feature, private message boards and a website builder. Its management side covers CC&R violation tracking, request forms, document storage, online voting and surveys, owner portals and resale documents. The vendor states it is used by more than 6,000 communities.
real_estate_use: Most American associations have no management company at all: a volunteer treasurer collects dues, keeps the books in a spreadsheet and mails paper notices. PayHOA is built for that person. It is the rare product in this category that publishes its price per community size and opens with a free trial rather than a demo, which is what makes it reachable for a board with no budget line for software. The mailroom feature matters more than it sounds, because an association is often legally obliged to send notices by post and doing that by hand is the treasurer's worst evening of the year. Management companies use it too, but its centre of gravity is the self-managed board.
features: General ledger accounting with budgets and board reports
Bank integrations removing manual transaction entry
Mass communication by text, email and phone
Mailroom for one-click USPS postal mailings
CC&R violation tracking and resident request forms

use_cases.job: Collect dues online and produce board financials without a management company
Send a legally required notice by post without handling envelopes
